summary: The table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending December 31, 2024, December 31, 2023, and September 30, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, and net profit, along with basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS). The table highlights year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth percentages. Notable insights include a 5.9% YoY increase in revenues from 2023 to 2024 and a 10.1% YoY growth in operating profit. The net profit before minority interest also shows a significant 9.8% YoY increase.
